meta.title: @remotion/google-fonts: Add AbortController support to loadFont() method
meta.body_summary: Add optional AbortController support to loadFont() in remotion/google-fonts to enable cancellation of font loading requests, claiming improved responsiveness for virtualized font picker UIs.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added AbortController to loadFont() across 199 font files; PR closed ~1.9h by maintainer without review interaction; narrative performance claim for virtualized font pickers.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 199 changed lines across 199 files, this is a small but wide-reaching mechanical edit. It fits a feature enhancement that was closed quickly without review engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comment from maintainer on the PR; only a Vercel bot deployment comment. PR was closed by maintainer JonnyBurger without substantive feedback, possibly due to the mechanical nature of the change across 199 font files.
review_details.performance_claim: Adding AbortController support allows cancellation of font loads, improving responsiveness in virtualized font pickers and avoiding unnecessary network requests.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by maintainer ~1.9h after creation with no review comments, suggesting it was deemed unnecessary or the approach not accepted.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot produced a mechanical 199-file change to add an optional AbortController parameter; despite linking an issue, no maintainer review was provided and the PR was closed. This suggests a process boundary where large but simple changes may still not be accepted without maintainer buy-in.

detection_detail.code_reading: No evidence of code-reading review in dataset; review was requested but no formal review text recorded.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics; only narrative claim about unnecessary network requests.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after ~1.9h with no review interaction; no fix-in-PR cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Added optional `controller?: AbortController` parameter to `loadFont()` in all 199 individual font module files under `packages/google-fonts/src/`. Each file got a one-line addition to the options type. The core cancellation logic was likely added in a shared module, but only the per-font files appear in the commit stats.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Only font-specific files are listed in commits; any shared loadFont logic changes are not captured in the file stats.
change_trajectory: Second commit: Added AbortController option to 199 font files; each modified with one-line addition.

review_signals.summary: Vercel bot posted deployment preview metadata; unrelated to perf validation.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR linked to issue with AbortController addition across 199 font files.
PR closed by maintainer JonnyBurger after ~1.9h without review comments.
